title: Beautiful Cathedral. Not...
text:
Very Beautiful Cathedral. Not to miss going up the tower. Palace was Amazing.
Our Tour guide was very good.
Strongly suggest  this tour if you are visiting Seville.
author: Suresh_B

title: Educational visit
text: An unforgettable visit. The Cathedral, the Giralda, and the Alcázar are impressive for their beauty and history. The guide made the tour enjoyable, with clear explanations and fascinating facts. Highly recommended!
author: Leslie_F

title: 2-2.5 hours which seemed...
text: 2-2.5 hours which seemed like the right length. Saw both the cathedral and the Alcazar. You are left to explore the gardens on your own.
author: Craig_R

title: Sensation tour of Alcaraz and cathedral in Seville
text: Amazing amount of historical information provided in a clear manner. Our tour guide Anna was excellent and provided humour along the way.
author: Alison_L

title: Great experience Anna was...
text: Great experience Anna was a wealth of knowledge and fun too. She definitely made the tour much more enjoyable
author: Lisa_B

title: Excellent experience with...
text: Excellent experience with an excellent guide! So much information to process over 2.5 hours but the guide was experienced enough to make sure we all understood...
author: Cristian_C

title: Santiago De Compostela
text: Very informative and great presentation. Enjoyed the trip very much. It was a very rainy day but we still enjoyed it.
author: Maria_A

title: Viva Raoul
text:
Guided tour with Raoul, smiling and with excellent Italian; available to repeat and provide new earphones that break quickly.
Despite the time of 13 the visit was very pleasant 
Raoul also left us useful tips on where to eat and what not to miss in Seville
author: D2363EPserenaf

title: Visit the Giralda and Alcazar de Sevilla
text: We discovered Seville with our Guide Marie-José. The visit was very pleasant, our Guide was very attentive, inviting and speaks in perfect French, which allowed our two daughters to know fully the history of the Giralda and the Alcazar Palace.
author: youssefsE8517KF

title: Perfect amount of information
text: Very informative and entertaining guide. She kept us together, showed us supplemental pictures, she was good at telling jokes, interacting with the small children on our group and she was organized.  The tour was perfect time for the brief descriptions our family wanted. If you are into history, deep details, art studies you may want a longer tour.  I highly recommend.
author: kristy_c
